svg.text: Request-level vs iteration-level batching (4 slots, one column per decode step)
Static or dynamic batching: the batch runs until its longest request finishes
Red slots are wasted: A, C and D are done, but E to H must wait for B. Only 30 of 56 slot-steps do work.
Continuous batching: finished requests leave, waiting ones join on the very next step
Every slot is busy on every step. Same GPU, same model, more tokens per second.
